text.p: These are the leading stories in the Lebanese press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- A solildarity meeting with arrested labour leader Elias Abou Rizk demands his immediate release. He was arrested five days ago on charges of impersonating the head of the General Labour Confederation.
- Defeated Christian opposition candidate in parliamentary elections last summer Albert Mokheiber accuses Syria of interfering in the elections.
- A third group of 486 Lebanese nationals arrive in Beirut from Sierra Leone on a flight of the national carrier Middle East Airlines.
- An invastigative judge will continue interrogation of pro-opposition labour Secretary General Yasser Neimeh for a second day today.
- Syrian Vice-President Abdel-Halim Khaddam to arrive in Beirut on Thursday on official visit.

- "We reject any security disturbance under the slogan of hunger revolution," Interior Minister Michel al-Murr says in an apparent response to a call by former head of pro-Iranian Hizbollah Sheikh Subhi Tofeili.
- President Elias Hrawi receives Iranian official.
- Middle East Airlines and Trans Mediterranean Airways cargo company sign memorandum of understanding to increase cooperation.
